Subject: Handoff: BrightLeaf — regression guardrail runbook & integration kickoff

Hi team,

Following our exec wrap earlier this week, BrightLeaf (Emily Carter) is ready to move into implementation. Key ask from sales: we need a short-but-rigorous quality monitoring setup that will catch regressions early and let their platform team run a staged canary with clear rollback criteria.

Summary / context:
- Account: BrightLeaf.ai (prod workload: clinical summarization pipeline)
- Target: prompt-level regression detection + an eval harness integration for CI gating
- Risk: high sensitivity on hallucination and PHI masking — customer requires evidence of runbooks and audit logs
- Timeline: kickoff next week; first canary in staging within 3 weeks

Can you take ownership of the handoff and propose the initial runway (owners, artifacts, and 2-week milestones)? I attached the brief MA plan and the signed SOW for context.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) 30-min kickoff with BrightLeaf + engineering (incl. their SRE) — please offer 3 slots
2) Share prompt-set template + labeling rubric for them to seed their critical prompts
3) Outline canary metrics and hard rollback conditions we can agree on before staging

Monica / Marissa — can you lead the QMon design? Soojin — please own the eval harness integration and the gating rules.

Thanks,
Rishi

Great — thanks everyone for the availability. Quick implementation runway and the proposed canary / rollback matrix I want us to agree on before the kickoff. Please review and flag anything missing.

Implementation runway (owners & 2-week milestones):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): CS collects and shares staging sample + access (BrightLeaf) — owner: Emily/Tom
- Week 1: Prompt-set ingestion + baseline eval run (Monica) — owner: Monica; deliverable: baseline report and labeled examples
- Week 2: Eval harness CI integration + automated regression tests (Sooj in + Eng) — owner: Soojin/Marissa; deliverable: GH Actions workflow + failure alerts to PagerDuty
- Week 3: Staging canary (48h window) and metric burn-in (Monica) — owner: Monica; deliverable: canary report and audit logs export

Regression guardrail matrix (high level):
- Metric A: Per-prompt regression rate (critical prompts) — threshold: > 3% regression vs baseline across 3 consecutive runs => auto-fail and block rollout
- Metric B: PHI leakage incidents — threshold: any non-zero event => immediate rollback and forensics
- Metric C: Hallucination severity (scored) — threshold: median severity delta > 0.2 => hold rollout and require manual triage
- Metric D: Median streaming latency — threshold: > 800ms 95th percentile => escalate to infra and throttle traffic

Canary policy (staging -> limited prod -> full rollout):
1) Staging: 48-hour run with synthetic and real-deidentified prompts; pass all guardrails for 2 consecutive runs
2) Prod limited: 72-hour run at 5–10% traffic; monitor alerts and SRE runbook checkpoints
3) Full rollout: gradual ramp to target traffic with continuous monitoring and automatic fallback to previous model for 10 minutes if an alert triggers

Rollback criteria (automated + manual):
- Automated rollback: triggers on Metric A/B above thresholds for 3 consecutive evaluation runs OR any PHI leakage event
- Manual rollback: engineering/SRE discretion if unusual spikes in latency or customer-reported failures; requires a documented incident summary and sign-off by CS/Eng

Eval harness integration notes:
- We'll add a GitHub Actions workflow that runs the eval harness on PRs and nightly baselines. Link to example: https://github.com/redwood-inference/brightleaf-eval-harness/actions
- Failure mode: single-run regression above guardrail should create a draft Jira (SUP-xxxxx) and page the on-call with the baseline report attached.

Action items before kickoff call (monitored in the handoff doc):
- Emily: share GCS path + sample of staging prompts (owner: Emily)
- Monica: validate promptset_template_v1.csv with the team and produce baseline within 5 business days (owner: Monica)
- Soojin/Marissa: draft GH Actions workflow and attach canary_runbook_v1.pdf to the repo (owner: Soojin/Marissa)

Attachments included with this email: regguard_matrix_v1.csv (CSV), canary_runbook_v1.pdf (pdf), eval_harness_links.txt (txt)
